$comment: Text pool for the Spiritual Warfare prayer category.
requests: Peace and protection over our home this week.
There has been so much tension in our house lately, and it feels heavier than normal arguments. Praying for the peace of Christ to fill every room and every heart.
I have been fighting discouragement for weeks. Every time I try to take a step forward in my faith, something knocks me down. I need strength to keep going.
Asking for strength against a temptation I thought I had left behind years ago. I am not giving up, but I am tired. I need God's help and the support of people who will pray.
My son has been having trouble sleeping and wakes up afraid at night. We pray over him at bedtime and would love for others to join us in asking for God's peace and rest.
Lifting up our marriage. We love each other but it feels like everything is working to pull us apart right now. Pray that we stand together and stand firm.
Since I started serving in kids ministry, it seems like one thing after another has gone wrong at home and at work. I know God is bigger. Pray for protection and endurance.

I have been in a spiritually dry and heavy season for a few months now. I still go to church and I still read my Bible, but it feels like my prayers hit the ceiling. I know feelings are not the whole truth, and I know God has not left me. I am asking for prayer that the light breaks through and that I would remember who I am in Christ.
Praying for our whole family to put on the full armor of God. We have had a lot of conflict, a lot of worry, and a lot of discouragement. We want to stand firm together.
Strength to resist temptation and choose what is right.
details: I know the battle belongs to the Lord, and I am choosing to trust Him with it.
Our small group has been praying with us, and it helps to know we are not alone in this.
Some days are better than others, but I can feel God's strength when I ask for it.
I would be grateful for prayer for peaceful sleep and a calm mind too.
God has been faithful before, and I believe He will be faithful again.
answers: Thank you for praying. Things are so much calmer now, and I can feel God's peace again.
Still in the fight, but I am not losing heart. Your prayers have made a real difference.
The heaviness has lifted. God is faithful and I am so grateful for this prayer team.
More good days than hard days lately. Thank you for continuing to cover this in prayer.
